purpose: Explicit source-compatible inventory history contracts. No real project/dataset is assumed or provisioned.

sharedColumns.id: STRING or lossless INTEGER; physical source audit ID
sharedColumns.store_name: nullable STRING; current source store dimension
sharedColumns.store_type: nullable STRING; storage audits require STORE
sharedColumns.store_active: BOOL; current source store active status
sharedColumns.storage_name: nullable STRING; NULL outside storage audit
sharedColumns.stock_before: STRING; original source JSON with insertion order intact
sharedColumns.stock_after: STRING; original source JSON with insertion order intact
sharedColumns.user: nullable STRING; exact source operator/customer display selection including Python strip semantics
sharedColumns.created_at: DATETIME in the explicitly configured source BUSINESS_TIMEZONE, not an implicit UTC conversion
sharedColumns.firstname: nullable STRING; source customer first name, product audit search only
sharedColumns.lastname: nullable STRING; source customer last name, product audit search only
sharedColumns.product_sort_key: nullable STRING; HEX(WEIGHT_STRING(source products.product using its verified source collation))
sharedColumns.erp_product_sort_key: nullable STRING; source ERP WEIGHT_STRING hex
sharedColumns.store_name_sort_key: nullable STRING; source store-name WEIGHT_STRING hex
sharedColumns.storage_name_sort_key: nullable STRING; source storage-name WEIGHT_STRING hex

likeFunction.signature: (value STRING, pattern STRING, source_column STRING) RETURNS BOOL
likeFunction.required: For non-empty historical search. Empty search does not need the UDF.
likeFunction.semantics: Reproduce the tagged source column's MySQL LIKE collation, NULL and backslash/%/_ behavior. LOWER or generic Unicode case-folding is insufficient.

sourceContracts.product: pos_product_inventory_logs INNER JOIN products, LEFT JOIN users/stores/pos_user; pos_user_id selects current POS operator name, otherwise customer firstname/lastname fallback
sourceContracts.held: pos_hold_stock_logs INNER JOIN products, LEFT JOIN stores/pos_user; no customer-name search/fallback
sourceContracts.storage: stock_storage_logs INNER JOIN products, LEFT JOIN stores/pos_user; source storage lookup uses log.storage_id=stock_storages.id then store_storages.id=stock_storages.id, not stock_storages.storage_id

verification: The listed current source collations are verified with read-only SHOW FULL COLUMNS in mysql-extra-schema.json and used by native differential fixtures. Warehouse UDF and imported WEIGHT_STRING keys must reproduce each tag's actual source profile; differentially verify deployed Unicode/accent/escape/sort behavior before production certification.
privacy: Customer/operator display fields are authorized response data only; never log rows, names, comments, patterns or request bodies. Apply store scope in both count and page queries.
